events.headline: Rippling opened an AI Lab in Bengaluru
events.summary: Rippling launched a research and engineering AI Lab at its Embassy Tech Village campus, expanded its Bengaluru workspace to 170,000 sq ft, and said it was hiring across AI research, applied AI, backend, platform engineering, machine learning, and engineering leadership.

events.headline: Rippling introduced new Rippling AI capabilities
events.summary: Rippling announced plugins, skills, and automations that connect approved third-party systems, package reusable instructions, and run recurring AI workflows under existing workforce policies and permissions.

events.headline: Rippling opened a new 132,693-square-foot New York City office
events.summary: The office at 330 West 34th Street supports more than 1,000 employees across go-to-market, engineering, product and design, operations, and corporate functions, nearly doubling Rippling's prior New York footprint.

events.headline: Rippling reintroduced Automated Compliance with expanded capabilities
events.summary: The release added multi-framework support, broader integrations, a built-in audit portal, publishable trust centers, and embedded AI workflows for framework setup, remediation, and security questionnaires.
